Author: Arty
Name: RollTracker
TestingChangelog:
IMPORTANT!

Chat channel dropdowns only control lines that do not already start with an explicit chat or macro command.

If your existing ToD macros still start lines with /y, /yell, /s, /say, /p, or /party, those lines will continue to use that written command and will ignore the new chat dropdown/global override for that line.

To let the new dropdown control a line, remove the chat command from the start of the line.

Example:
Before: /y Time for Truth or Dare!
After: Time for Truth or Dare!

Macro commands like /wait 10 still work normally and should stay as macro commands.

Changes

- Added chat channel dropdowns for normal and double Truth or Dare rounds, including macro text, result output, and not-enough-player messages.
- Added a persistent global chat override in Settings > Global controls.
- Added a dedicated chat channel dropdown for Special Rules output.
- Added Special Rules Range Rules with grouped output, do-not-trigger support, exact-rule overlap control, and overlap warnings.
- Reworked Special Rules into separate Exact Rules and Range Rules subtabs.
- Improved the Special Rules set manager so it lists Exact and Range sets together and highlights active overlaps.
- Added help popups and tooltips for Exact Rules, Range Rules, Do not trigger with fields, ToD macro chat behavior, and global chat override behavior.
- Added draggable vertical resize handles for Exact Rules and Range Rules tables.
- Fixed Status Effects cleanup after fast logout so stale Honorific forced titles are retried after the next stable login when no linked module should keep a title active.
Description:
Reads chat messages, detects /random rolls, tracks Truth or Dare rounds, and provides configurable !truth, !dare, !help, !tod2, and !wifi helpers.

Commands:
/rt - open or close the window.
/rt help - show the full command and trigger list locally.
Punchline: Tracks /random rolls for private round games.
